name: badge
useFor: Use pink for a feature or role marker beside a label (BETA, ADMIN), success size lg with a filled check-circle for something granted (Included), blue, purple and gray at size sm for event tags (Email, Signed, Fire-and-forget), green size sm for a rule mode (Blacklist), and size well for a status reading (Active on green, Idle on gray, Edge on blue). Default (purple) and destructive are for counts and errors.
constraints: More than three badges in a row
source: Figma 427:2715: the rail (BETA, ADMIN), Create Agent Identity (Included), Webhooks (Email, Signed, Fire-and-forget), iMessage (Blacklist), Tunnel (Active, Idle, Edge), Inbox (Unread)
title: Badge
description: The pink BETA and ADMIN marks, the green Included pill, the pale webhook tags, and the tunnel's status wells.
